name: Android App Analysis
content:
Analyze the Android application {apk_path}.

**Static analysis :**
```bash
# Decompilation
apktool d {apk_path} -o output/
jadx -d output_java/ {apk_path}

# Strings and secrets
strings {apk_path} | grep -i api
grep -r "password\|secret\|key" output/
```

**Items to check :**
1. AndroidManifest.xml : permissions, exported components
2. Hardcoded secrets in the code
3. SSL certificate pinning
4. Root detection
5. Local storage (SharedPrefs, SQLite)

**Dynamic analysis (Frida) :**
```javascript
// Bypass SSL pinning
frida -U -f com.app.name -l ssl-bypass.js

// Bypass root detection
frida -U -f com.app.name -l root-bypass.js
```

**MobSF (automated) :**
```bash
docker run -p 8000:8000 opensecurity/mobile-security-framework-mobsf
```

Tools : jadx, apktool, Frida, objection, MobSF
